dimensions.assessment: Affects small businesses bidding on federal contract solicitations that get cancelled, as well as federal agency procurement officers and OSDBU directors.
dimensions.evidence: refer a small business that prepared a bid for such covered solicitation to the Office of Small and Disadvantaged Business Utilization

dimensions.assessment: Provides procedural justifications and referral assistance without altering the fundamental contracting authority.
dimensions.evidence: an agency must provide a justification for the cancellation, information about any plans to reissue

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits any additional funds from being authorized to carry out the act.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to carry out the requirements of this Act

dimensions.assessment: Requires the Small Business Administration to issue new rules and amends section 15(k) of the Small Business Act.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Small Business Administration (SBA) to issue rules for disclosing information about federal contract solicitations

dimensions.assessment: Permanent procedural requirement for federal procurement agencies and the SBA.

missing_information: Number of cancelled solicitations per year across federal agencies
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes new SBA rules and agency duties regarding cancelled federal solicitations for small businesses, creating limited administrative and procedural changes.
